-- [AnimePlayer: queue activate]
	on_activate = function(event)
		-- [AnimePlayer: queue as a tab, activate] (the Queue row is gone: Queue is a tab next to Playlist)
		if event.action == 'queue_tools' then
			mp.commandv('script-message', 'ap-queue-menu')
		elseif event.action == 'play_next' or event.action == 'move_end' then
			local from = event.value - 1
			local cur = mp.get_property_number('playlist-pos', 0)
			local count = mp.get_property_number('playlist-count', 0)
			if event.action == 'play_next' then
				if from ~= cur and from ~= cur + 1 then mp.commandv('playlist-move', tostring(from), tostring(cur + 1)) end
			elseif from ~= count - 1 then
				mp.commandv('playlist-move', tostring(from), tostring(count))
			end
		else
			mp.commandv('set', 'playlist-pos-1', tostring(event.value))
		end
	end,
	on_paste = function(event) mp.commandv('loadfile', tostring(event.value), 'append') end,
	on_key = function(event)
		if event.id == 'ctrl+c' and event.selected_item and type(event.selected_item.value) == 'number' then  -- [AnimePlayer: queue tab]
			local payload = mp.get_property_native('playlist/' .. (event.selected_item.value - 1) .. '/filename')
			set_clipboard(payload)
		end
	end,
	on_move = function(event)
		-- [AnimePlayer: queue as a tab, move] row n is playlist item n again
		mp.commandv('playlist-move', tostring(event.from_index - 1), tostring(event.to_index - (event.to_index > event.from_index and 0 or 1)))
	end,
	on_remove = function(event) if type(event.value) == 'number' then mp.commandv('playlist-remove', tostring(event.value - 1)) end end,
}))
-- [v4.5] History UOSC Bind
bind_command('history', function()

-- [AnimePlayer: queue activate] -- [AP7:auto-main-lua-4]
	on_activate = function(event)
		-- [AnimePlayer: queue as a tab, activate] (the Queue row is gone: Queue is a tab next to Playlist)
		if event.action == 'show_in_folder' then
			local path = mp.get_property('playlist/' .. (ap_real(event.value) - 1) .. '/filename')
			if path then mp.commandv('script-message', 'ap-show-in-explorer', path) end
		elseif event.action == 'add_queue' then
			local path = mp.get_property('playlist/' .. (ap_real(event.value) - 1) .. '/filename')
			if path then mp.commandv('script-message', 'ap-queue-add', path) end
		elseif event.action == 'play_next' or event.action == 'move_end' then
			local from = ap_real(event.value) - 1
			local cur = mp.get_property_number('playlist-pos', 0)
			local count = mp.get_property_number('playlist-count', 0)
			if event.action == 'play_next' then
				-- [AP15] behind a staged queue video (hidden entry right after the playing one) when there is one
				local after = cur + 1
				local next_id = mp.get_property_native('playlist/' .. (cur + 1) .. '/id')
				if next_id and ap_hidden[tostring(next_id)] then after = cur + 2 end
				if from ~= cur and from ~= after then mp.commandv('playlist-move', tostring(from), tostring(from < after and after + 1 or after)) end
			elseif from ~= count - 1 then
				mp.commandv('playlist-move', tostring(from), tostring(count))
			end
		else
			mp.commandv('set', 'playlist-pos-1', tostring(ap_real(event.value)))
		end
	end,
	on_paste = function(event) mp.commandv('loadfile', tostring(event.value), 'append') end,
	on_key = function(event)
		if event.id == 'ctrl+c' and event.selected_item and type(event.selected_item.value) == 'number' then  -- [AnimePlayer: queue tab]
			local payload = mp.get_property_native('playlist/' .. (ap_real(event.selected_item.value) - 1) .. '/filename')
			set_clipboard(payload)
		end
	end,
	on_move = function(event)
		-- [AnimePlayer: queue as a tab, move] row n is playlist item n again
		-- [AP15] rows -> real indices (a hidden entry may sit between them)
		local from0, to_real0 = ap_real(event.from_index) - 1, ap_real(event.to_index) - 1
		mp.commandv('playlist-move', tostring(from0), tostring(event.to_index > event.from_index and to_real0 + 1 or to_real0))
	end,
	on_remove = function(event) if type(event.value) == 'number' then mp.commandv('playlist-remove', tostring(ap_real(event.value) - 1)) end end,
}))
